What is a hex, and what is a patch?

A synthetic coast with straight runs, a seven-hex lake, a three-hex lake, a two-hex lake, a single-hex lake, and an island. Dark border hexes enclose the sample, so its side and bottom boundaries also receive patches. Click a hex to inspect its original neighbors and the patch it receives.

Patch decisions always use the original colors. Turning off a patch only hides that contribution; it does not recalculate the other rules.
